WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.accindex, a.platident, m.netinflscore, m.coordscore, m.clustrole,
         sb.sesscount,
         cb.postfreq,
         nm.network_engagement_metrics->'connection_metrics'->>'connqualscore' AS connqualscore,
         nm.network_engagement_metrics->'interaction_metrics'->>'interactdiv' AS interactdiv
  FROM account a
  JOIN profile p ON p.profaccref = a.accindex
  JOIN sessionbehavior sb ON sb.sessprofref = p.profkey
  LEFT JOIN contentbehavior cb ON cb.cntsessref = sb.sessref
  LEFT JOIN networkmetrics nm ON nm.netsessref = sb.sessref
  JOIN moderationaction m ON m.macntref = cb.cntref
  WHERE m.clustrole='Amplifier' AND m.coordscore>0.8
),
agg AS (
  SELECT accindex, platident,
         MAX(netinflscore) AS netinflscore,
         SUM(postfreq) AS tpf,
         SUM(sesscount) AS sc,
         MAX(connqualscore::numeric) AS connqualscore,
         MAX(interactdiv::numeric) AS interactdiv
  FROM base GROUP BY accindex, platident
),
nic AS (
  SELECT *, (0.4*connqualscore + 0.3*netinflscore + 0.3*interactdiv) AS nic FROM agg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT n.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM nic n2 WHERE n2.nic > n.nic) + 1 AS influence_rank
  FROM nic n
),
clust AS (
  SELECT platident, count(DISTINCT accindex) AS member_count FROM agg GROUP BY platident
)
SELECT r.accindex, r.netinflscore, r.tpf AS posting_frequency, c.member_count, r.influence_rank
FROM ranked r JOIN clust c ON c.platident = r.platident
WHERE r.influence_rank <= 10
ORDER BY r.netinflscore DESC
LIMIT 100;
